executionScenarios.name: classifies-factual
executionScenarios.description: A clearly factual topic is classified into one of the three categories
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The input topic is 'The fall of the Roman Empire'. The Gemini model returns a classification of 'FACTUAL' with a brief rationale.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow executes without errors and produces a single category value that is one of FACTUAL, FICTIONAL, or HYBRID for the given topic.

conversation.text: I'm building a Story OS pipeline. I want a workflow where I feed in a topic, title, or idea and a Gemini model classifies it into exactly one of three categories — FACTUAL, FICTIONAL, or HYBRID — so I can route it to the right downstream pipeline. I'll paste the topic in as the input.

description: Sourced from a real Instance AI conversation (thread 1b0b0e1c) that built and executed successfully: a 'Story OS' topic-classification step. Tests that the LLM output is constrained to a fixed enum of categories, not free-form text.
outcomeExpectations: The workflow takes a topic/idea as its input and can be run on demand (e.g. a Manual or Chat trigger).
It calls a Google Gemini model to classify the input text.
The classification is constrained to exactly one of the three categories FACTUAL, FICTIONAL, or HYBRID (e.g. via the prompt and/or a structured/parsed output), rather than returning free-form text.
